subject: Re: EdgeOps x Redwood: Customer Sprints mini-summit — draft agenda & next steps
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna@edgeops.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@edgeops.com, samir@cloudforge.co
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeOps x Redwood: Customer Sprints mini-summit proposal

Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — excited to explore a small, focused event that surfaces how customers run LLMs in production. EdgeOps would like to co-host a half-day "Customer Sprints" mini-summit in mid-November (virtual + one recorded customer panel). Goals are: share real-world runbooks, highlight observability + cost controls, and capture short how-to clips for both our blogs.

High level proposal:
- Date window: Nov 10–17 (flexible)
- Format: 3 talks (15m), 1 customer panel (30m), 15m live Q&A, plus a 3–4 minute highlight video
- Shared promotion: blog swap, 2 social posts each, joint registration page

I attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan to get to a confirmed date. Looking for Redwood to: confirm speakers (1 product/1 customer), own registration (or we can share), and provide a short tech demo slot focused on the Redwood runtime for latency/cost optimizations.

Do you have bandwidth to run this? If yes, we can lock dates and loop in your PM and field team.

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Partnerships, EdgeOps
attachments: EdgeOps_Redwood_mini-summit_agenda_v1.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan_edgeops_redwood.xlsx

Anna — great to meet this. Thanks for the clear proposal and the agenda. We're keen. Quick notes from our side: 

- Preferred window: Nov 12 or Nov 16 (avoid the 11/11 holiday week start for customers)
- Redwood speaker: Karthik can cover the "runtime in production" 15m slot + 3–4m demo. He'll focus on batching, KV caching, and model routing policies.
- Customer panel: Ben can reach out to two pilot customers (one SaaS, one fintech) to secure confirmations this week.
- Registration: let's do a joint page. We can host if EdgeOps prefers co-branded landing copy.

Logistics ask: can you confirm the recording/rights language (we prefer evergreen asset reuse for blogs) so legal can review the DocuSign? I see the Drive folder and the HubSpot record — I'll add action owners to the mutual action plan.

I've attached an internal checklist we'll use to track speaker confirmations, promo assets, recording rights, and follow-up sequences. Karthik, Ben, Irene — can you confirm availability for Nov 12 / Nov 16 and who will own which deliverables?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- 8m: production tactics (continuous batching, prefix caching, model variants and routing) with a couple of micro-benchmarks
- 5m: demo (dashboard trace showing a QoS policy kicking in + cost delta after caching)
